description: This file contains JavaScript code for creating and validating a 'To-Do' task in a CRM workflow module, including functions for time parsing, error handling, picklist filling, and date range validation, as well as initializing web service calls to describe object fields and set up the UI.

methods.name: parse12HoursTime
methods.description: Parses a 12-hour format time string into total minutes.

methods.name: errorDialog
methods.description: Displays an alert dialog with the given message.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Creates a dictionary mapping field values to objects from an array.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Wraps a function to handle success or failure status.

methods.name: fillPicklist
methods.description: Populates a select element with picklist options based on field info.
